lines.zh: 我贴着草丛走，肩胛起伏
lines.en: I move along the grass, shoulders rolling.

lines.zh: 我的爪子落地几乎没有声音
lines.en: My paws land almost soundlessly.
My tail sways slowly behind me.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，从一段坡下滑过
lines.en: I keep low and slip down a slope.
I avoid the dead branches in the woods.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我的身体长
lines.en: My shadow outruns my body.
I listen to the ground, not the wind.

lines.zh: 我的肩胛骨在皮毛下滑动
lines.en: My shoulder blades slide under the fur.
One stride clears a brook.
I turn close around a trunk.

lines.zh: 我没有声音，直到我想有
lines.en: I make no sound until I choose to.

lines.zh: 我从一块石头跳到另一块
lines.en: I leap from stone to stone.

lines.zh: 我伏在岩石上，尾巴垂着
lines.en: I lie on the rock, tail hanging.

lines.zh: 太阳落在我背上的毛里
lines.en: Sun sinks into the fur of my back.
The forest wind has turned.
My claws are sheathed.
I am still, but my eyes are not.
My whiskers stir in the wind.

lines.zh: 岩石边缘有我踩出的浅坑
lines.en: My paws have worn shallow dips in the rock.
The shadows lengthen; time to move.
I patrol this dry forest alone.
Nothing else stirs in the woods.
I lift my head from the rock.
My eyes meet yours, level.

lines.zh: 你身上有别的野兽的味道
lines.en: You carry the smell of other beasts.
I hold still and watch you first.

lines.zh: 你不是猎物，也不是猎人
lines.en: You are neither prey nor hunter.
The tip of my tail flicks.
In dry woods I keep to myself.
You stepped back; I noted it.
My ears angle toward you.
I am wondering whether you can run.
My claws rake the soil; I am not finished.

lines.zh: 我的一条腿不太敢踩实
lines.en: One leg will not take my weight.
Blood is in my fur.
I crouch to guard my belly.
My ears flatten back.
I shake my head hard.

lines.zh: 我退到灌木里，压低身子
lines.en: I fall back into the brush and crouch.
One foreleg gives way.
Blood mats my fur.
I growl and edge backward.
Raw venison; that is the right smell.
I do not need feeding; I will take it.
My nose works the air.

lines.zh: 你给我这个，我就让你走
lines.en: Give me that and I will let you pass.

lines.zh: 我慢慢站起来，尾巴放平
lines.en: I rise slowly, tail level.

lines.zh: 我在你手边停下，没有抢
lines.en: I stop at your hand and do not snatch.
This smell reminds me of snow.
I take it and back off two steps.
Keep your hand still; I am not done.
I will not thank you, but I will not bite.
I turn and you hit empty air.
Our shoulders meet.
I give half a step and crouch.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴，我甩开
lines.en: You step on my tail; I flick it free.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上抓了一下
lines.en: My claws dig in once.
I do not like being bumped.
We part and each hold our ground.
You ruffle my fur upright.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖撞在我的肋上
lines.en: Your knee meets my ribs.

lines.zh: 我一扭身，把你挤到一边
lines.en: I twist and shove you aside.
She lies on another rock.
We look at each other across a gap.
She blinks first; I do not.

lines.zh: 我们绕着圈走，谁都不低头
lines.en: We circle, neither lowering our heads.
Her coat is darker than mine.

lines.zh: 山林这么大，够我们两个
lines.en: The woods are big enough for us both.

lines.zh: 我们并肩趴下，尾巴挨着
lines.en: We lie down side by side, tails touching.

lines.zh: 她替我舔了一下肩上的伤
lines.en: She licks the wound on my shoulder.
We neither yowl nor quarrel.

lines.zh: 这一片坡地，我也留给她
lines.en: I leave this slope to her too.
I lower my head and take up a piece of meat.
I drag it under the tree roots to hide it.
I drag it under a root to hide.
I carry it across the brook.
My jaws are steady; it does not drop.
I drag this meat under the tree.
I lift my head with it in my jaws.
I lay it between my forepaws.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻才决定要不要
lines.en: I sniff first before deciding.

lines.zh: 我把它甩到背上，甩不掉
lines.en: I toss it up and it will not stay.
My body drops low at once.
My ears face fully forward.
You moved; that is enough.
My hind legs gather.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫了猎物就跑了
lines.en: I do not roar; that would spook the prey.
My claws come out.

lines.zh: 生鹿排的味道，我记住你了。
lines.en: The smell of raw venison: I remember you.
My tail stops swaying.
Seven paces is enough for one pounce.
I begin to creep forward, very slowly.

lines.zh: 你没有发现我已经不在石头上
lines.en: You have not noticed I left the rock.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在土里按出印子
lines.en: My claws press prints into the soil.
I sink until I am almost flat.
In the grass, I flatten my shoulders.
The wind is right; now I can move.
I have chosen the shortest line.
I trail you low, unhurried.

lines.zh: 我的影子一直在你侧边
lines.en: My shadow stays at your flank.
You go left; I take the right.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一段固定距离
lines.en: A fixed gap stays between us.
I drive you down the slope.
The more you run, the wilder your steps.

lines.zh: 我沿着坡边走，影子在草里
lines.en: I move along the slope, shadow in grass.

lines.zh: 我伏在枯枝后，数你的步。
lines.en: Behind the dead branches, I count your steps.
I wait for you to walk into it.
I keep my breathing very light.

lines.zh: 你听见我了，可你找不到
lines.en: You heard me, but cannot find me.

lines.zh: 我从一棵树后换到另一棵
lines.en: I slip from one tree to the next.

lines.zh: 灌木把我的身体挡住了
lines.en: The brush hides my body.
Your footsteps cover mine.
I stay downwind of you.

lines.zh: 你在找眼睛，我不给你眼睛
lines.en: You look for eyes; I give you none.
I steer you toward the steep bank.

lines.zh: 你每一步都在往我这边偏
lines.en: Every step of yours drifts my way.
I am patient; the slope is long.

lines.zh: 你背对着我，这就是机会
lines.en: Your back is to me; that is the chance.
I spring from the side.
My forepaws strike your shoulder.
My teeth close and hold.

lines.zh: 我一击就退开，重新压低
lines.en: One strike and I am off, low again.

lines.zh: 我的后腿蹬地，把你撞倒
lines.en: My hind legs drive you down.

lines.zh: 我的爪子划过你的手臂
lines.en: My claws rake your arm.
My forepaws pin your back.
I bite upward at your leg.
I leap and put all my weight in.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在你衣上留下四道
lines.en: My claws leave four lines on your coat.

lines.zh: 我一击就退，绕到另一侧
lines.en: One strike, then I circle to the other side.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿磕到你的护腕
lines.en: My teeth clack on your bracer.

lines.zh: 你挡住我的爪，挡不住我的牙
lines.en: You stop my claws, not my teeth.
I leap down the slope into you.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的裤脚往坡下拖
lines.en: I bite your hem and drag you downhill.

lines.zh: 我一扭身，尾巴扫你的脸
lines.en: I twist and my tail sweeps your face.

lines.zh: 我的扑击落空了，立刻翻身
lines.en: My pounce misses; I roll at once.

lines.zh: 我压在你身上，喘得很近
lines.en: I hold you down, breathing close.

lines.zh: 你一推，我顺势滑到侧面
lines.en: You shove and I slide to your flank.

lines.zh: 我的爪子刮到石头，火星出来
lines.en: My claws scrape stone and spark.

lines.zh: 我从坡上的树后走出来
lines.en: I step out from behind a tree on the slope.

lines.zh: 我的爪子先落在石头上
lines.en: My paws land on rock first.
My tail lifts behind me.
The birds in the woods fly first.
I lower my head and sniff this ground.
This slope is mine; I have noted it.
I come down through the fallen leaves.
My tail shows through the brush first.

lines.zh: 我在坡上停了停，看清四周
lines.en: I pause on the slope to read the ground.

lines.zh: 这片林子里有我的气味
lines.en: My scent is already in these woods.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖皮毛上的雨水
lines.en: I shake the rain from my coat.

lines.zh: 我抬起一条腿，在树上留了记号
lines.en: I raise a leg and mark the tree.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的毛，我打了个滚
lines.en: Fire catches my fur and I roll.

lines.zh: 我从岩石上摔下，落地很重
lines.en: I fall from the rock and land hard.

lines.zh: 水没到我的背，我蹬得很急
lines.en: Water reaches my back and I kick hard.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀起来，摔进灌木
lines.en: The blast throws me into the brush.
An arrow pierces my hind leg.

lines.zh: 那股力量钻进我的骨头
lines.en: That force enters my bones.

lines.zh: 饿了几天，我的肋骨都出来了
lines.en: Days hungry, and my ribs show.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我整只都麻了
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and numbs me whole.

lines.zh: 脚下没有坡了，我一直往下
lines.en: No slope underfoot; I fall and fall.
